title: .respawnpack/runtime/atomic-task-<sessionId>.json — the in-flight task note
description: ⛔ DELIBERATELY OPEN, AND THE JUSTIFICATION IS THE POINT. This pack has NO writer for this file — it is authored by /savepoint, by the goal contract, or by hand. hooks/precompact-ledger-nudge.js parses it opaquely and embeds it verbatim in the handoff; hooks/session-routing-nudge.js renders it with JSON.stringify. NO FIELD OF IT IS ACCESSED BY NAME ANYWHERE IN THE TREE (verified by the reader-coverage fence). Constraining a shape nothing reads would invent a contract out of someone else's file and manufacture failures from it. What IS declared: it must be a JSON object, because that is the only thing the consumers assume. If a reader ever starts naming a field, the reader-coverage fence fails here and this schema must grow to match — which is exactly the drift signal it exists to give.
